{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Verify the total count of orders
total_orders = len(sales_df)

# Count completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Verify that refunded orders are the only other status
refunded_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

# Check if the sum of completed and refunded orders equals total
assert total_orders == completed_orders + refunded_orders, "The sum of completed and refunded orders does not match total orders."

# Display results
completed_orders"}
